info.name: Get the Runbook for an SLX

params.name: detail
params.description: Accepted for Django parity; ignored (always returns full detail)

items.docs:
Get the Runbook for an SLX.

SLX and Runbook have a 1:1 relationship. This endpoint returns the single
Runbook associated with the specified SLX, or 404 if no Runbook exists.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    slx_short_name: The SLX short name.
    _detail: Django parity query param (ignored).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The Runbook details.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace, SLX, or Runbook not found.
